description: Audit and test all Cloudflare Worker deployment issues: ensure the edge worker builds, deploys correctly (wrangler.toml config), all middleware works correctly, proxy handles backend failures gracefully, and add comprehensive integration-style tests for the full request pipeline.
steps: WRANGLER CONFIG AUDIT: Review apps/edge/wrangler.toml - verify KV namespace bindings are correctly structured for production deployment, compatibility_date is recent enough for nodejs_compat flag, and environment-specific vars are properly scoped.

TYPE SAFETY AUDIT: Run tsc --noEmit and fix any type errors. Review apps/edge/src/env.d.ts to ensure all bindings match wrangler.toml (R2_BUCKET, RATE_LIMIT_KV, ISR_CACHE_KV, secrets). Currently ISR_CACHE_KV is only in env.production but referenced in code - ensure it works in dev mode too.

PROXY RESILIENCE: In apps/edge/src/routes/api-proxy.ts, the proxy catches errors and returns 503. Add timeout handling - if the backend takes >30s, return 504 Gateway Timeout instead of waiting indefinitely. Also ensure the Content-Length header deletion doesn't break non-stream POST requests.

JWT EDGE CASE: In apps/edge/src/middleware/jwt.ts, the verifyJWT function skips auth for paths starting with PUBLIC_PATHS entries. Verify that '/api/v1/admin/login' and '/api/v1/admin/logout' are correctly in PUBLIC_PATHS (they are). Verify that '/api/webhooks' is public (it is - webhook needs to accept Razorpay callbacks without JWT).

RATE LIMIT KV BINDING: The wrangler.toml only defines RATE_LIMIT_KV in [env.production]. The default environment has no KV binding, which means `npx wrangler dev` will fail when hitting rate-limited endpoints. Add a note/fallback or define preview bindings at the top level.

ISR CACHE BINDING: Similar to rate limit - ISR_CACHE_KV only exists in production env. The handleISR function will throw if env.ISR_CACHE_KV is undefined in local dev. Add null-check guard in apps/edge/src/routes/isr.ts.

ADD DEPLOYMENT TEST: Create apps/edge/tests/deployment-audit.test.ts that tests the full Worker fetch handler (index.ts default export) with mocked env bindings covering: (a) CORS preflight returns correct headers, (b) health endpoint proxies to backend, (c) rate-limited endpoint with KV mock, (d) R2 asset serving, (e) 404 fallback, (f) backend timeout returns 503.
ADD PROXY TEST: Create apps/edge/tests/api-proxy.test.ts that tests proxyRequest function directly: successful proxy, stream handling, backend failure (503), header injection (X-Real-IP, CF-Ray-ID).
ADD ISR TEST: Create apps/edge/tests/isr.test.ts that tests handleISR: bot UA gets cached response, non-bot UA returns null, cache hit returns from KV, cache miss proxies to backend.
acceptance_criteria: All existing edge tests continue to pass
New deployment-audit.test.ts tests pass covering the full request pipeline
New api-proxy.test.ts tests pass covering proxy scenarios
New isr.test.ts tests pass covering ISR bot caching
ISR handler gracefully handles missing ISR_CACHE_KV binding (returns null instead of throwing)
Proxy handles timeout scenarios with appropriate error response
verification: Run `pnpm --filter syrabit-edge test` shows all tests passing including new test files
